# aiwaitress.com

> aiwaitress.com is a premium two-word .com domain name that is for sale. The name pairs "AI" with "waitress" to describe anticipatory, personalized AI service — an assistant that already knows what you like and offers it before you ask.

The domain is offered for one-time acquisition at $8,888 USD, with escrow-protected transfer via Escrow.com and a personal response to serious buyers within 24 hours.

## Key facts

- Domain: aiwaitress.com
- Status: Available for acquisition (clean title, ready for transfer)
- Asking price: $8,888 USD, one-time
- Seller contact: sales@desertrich.com
- Transfer: Escrow.com protected, typically 1-5 business days

- Restaurant and hospitality technology (AI ordering, table-side recommendations, loyalty)

## Why the name works

- "AI waitress" is plain, searchable English with instant mental imagery.
- Two words, spelled exactly as spoken — easy to say, type, and remember.
- Exact-match brandable .com names in this pattern are effectively exhausted.
